svg.text: Vertex uses live GPS to walk you across campus and pick the best door. Then it keeps going
where GPS can't: up the right stairs, down the right hallway, to the room on your schedule.
West entrance to room 342: about 55 m inside and two floors up. The orange line is the route Vertex gives.
